question: is the residual slider failure a capability limit or an actuator-resolution limit?

three_measurements_of_the_same_task.policy: drag to a computed pixel (open loop)
drag, read #val, correct by residual (closed loop, drag actuator)
three_measurements_of_the_same_task.note: converged on coarse error (50 -> 101 fixed); stalled on 14->10, 3->2, 106->109

three_measurements_of_the_same_task.policy: focus handle, step with ArrowLeft/ArrowRight, read #val each step

result: 10/10 with a signed-integer goal parser, including negative targets (-67, -21, -35). Median 18 keystrokes.
the_law_this_confirms: the residual failure was the actuator, not the agent. A drag moves in pixel quanta and cannot express every integer on a narrow track; a key press expresses exactly one unit. Raising resolution converted 0/6 and 2/5 into 10/10 with no change to any policy logic, no learning, and no new verbs beyond 'press a key'.
why_this_is_the_most_important_result_of: it isolates the last remaining 'impossible' cell in the table and shows it was an INTERFACE property, not a model property. Together with the earlier findings, every single 'the agent cannot do this' claim tested this session resolved to one of: a reading bug, an addressing bug, a resolution bug, or a missing observation channel. None resolved to 'the learner is not good enough'.
the_two_exclusions_that_were_also_my_bug: the first arrow-key run reported 6/6 of 6 measured and excluded two episodes because the goal regex was \d+ and the targets were -99 and -93. Changing it to -?\d+ yielded 10/10. An exclusion caused by a parser is not a capability datum.

the_first_principles_summary_of_the_whol.learning: solved. One demonstration gave 2/6 -> 8/8 permanent, and 9/10 transfer to a different task.
the_first_principles_summary_of_the_whol.transfer_boundary: procedures that express RELATIONS transfer across families (drag 6/6 first try). Procedures that require CALIBRATION do not (slider 0/6 open loop).
the_first_principles_summary_of_the_whol.the_repair: calibration failures are repaired by a closed loop (0 -> 2/5) and completed by raising actuator resolution (-> 10/10).

what_is_still_not_established: a whole-benchmark reach figure on MiniWob++ 130 (never measured; the 10-task sample was chosen because earlier policies failed it)
whether RELATION-type procedures transfer beyond menus and boxes to canvas, games, or desktop apps
the GDPval-AA elo target, which requires a benchmark this sandbox cannot reach
